span.p:
Show event form
Active categories are selectable

div.style: color: rgb(12, 74, 110) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Enter title, description, category,
location, start, end, and status

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Validate fields, category, and schedule
End must follow start; changed schedule
must be in the future

span.p:
Create event in a transaction
Set creator and attach creator
as event leader

span.p:
Leader may update event details/status,
add or remove members, and manage tasks

span.p:
Validate and save changes
Write audit entry

span.p:
Notify other members for event updates
when their event_updates preference is enabled

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Add a unique event_members row
with role member

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Notify new member if preference allows

span.p:

and unassign their event tasks
